'''Tari Darkspanner''' (known by her followers as '''the Master''', later known as '''Lord Darkspanner''') was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who was the [[Master of the Order of Revan|master]] of the [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] known as the [[Order of Revan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Tari Darkspanner founded the [[Order of Revan]] after learning of [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] during her time on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] as a [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith acolyte]]. She learned of Revan's [[Attack on the Sith Emperor|visit]] to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] three centuries prior to the Cold War, and believed that he had overthrown the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] and sat in his throne.

She lived within the [[Revanite compound]] on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of Dromund Kaas. Initiates who completed their pilgrimage were granted an audience with "her" in the form of a hologram of a man dressed as Revan. But she later appeared in person to a new cult member and asked them to help keep the cult safe from [[Darth Charnus]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Emic Sandor]].

[[File:Master_of_the_Revanites.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Tari Darkspanner's Master]]
Darkspanner eventually learned of Revan's true fate when the man himself appeared to her in a vision, requesting her to leave Dromund Kaas to find him. Revan, impressed with Darkspanner and all she had accomplished with the Order of Revan, offered her the opportunity to expand the order's roster and purpose. Granted the title of Lord Darkspanner, she served as one of Revan's most trusted commanders until her death on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] by joint champions of the Empire and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].

==Behind the scenes==
Tari Darkspanner is a character from the [[2011]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' MMORPG [[Star Wars video games|video game]]. She appears during the [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] Revanite missions exclusive to Imperial players.

Upon the completion of the Revanites' trials, Darkspanner offers the player(s) a way to get the Empire off the trail of the Revanites; she had procured a Sith amulet from Darth Charnus and she wants the player(s) to give it to Sandor to frame his master as the Revanites' leader. The player(s) can either go along with Darkspanner's plan, setting Sandor against Charnus (light side dialogue); or identify Darkspanner to Sandor, allowing the Dark Council to capture her (dark side dialogue). Given that Charnus later appears during the [[Battle of Corellia]], and Darkspanner later re-emerges on Yavin 4, both efforts would not achieve their intended aim.
